description: End-to-end workflow for detecting, reviewing, and resolving SIM swap fraud related to telco orders and account changes, from initial alert through case closure and financial reconciliation.

functions.returns: Risk assessment including risk_score, alert_id (if escalated), and recommended action (allow, step_up_auth, block, review).
